title: Companies (General Provisions and Forms) Regulations, 2018

source.name: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan

verification.note: Demonstration extract for layout only. Confirm the S.R.O. number and text against the Gazette before quoting.

preamble: In exercise of the powers conferred by the Companies Act, 2017, the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan is pleased to make the following regulations.

sections.title: Short title and commencement
text: (1) These regulations may be called the Companies (General Provisions and Forms) Regulations, 2018.
(2) They shall come into force at once.

sections.title: Definitions
text: (1) In these regulations, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,—
>(b) "form" means a form specified in these regulations.
(2) Words and expressions used but not defined in these regulations shall have the same meaning as in the Act.
